screen.isekai_mahou.journal.campaign.on: Campaign ON: the Echo tells the world's story at the milestones of your journey. Click to turn it off — nothing is lost, it all stays here in the Journal.
screen.isekai_mahou.journal.campaign.off: Campaign OFF: no story lines or cutscenes. Each chapter's "Echoes" stay here to read whenever you like. Click to turn it on.
hint.isekai_mahou.journal_where: Not sure where to get something? B menu → Travel Guide → Where?
screen.isekai_mahou.where.sub: where it is and how it works
screen.isekai_mahou.where.next_none: No open objective right now. Explore, look after your city — or pick a topic on the left.
screen.isekai_mahou.where.next_tip: The tracker arrow (J key) points to the place when the step has one. The topics on the left tell you where to get everything else.
isekai_mahou.configuration.storyCampaign: The Echo (Guide Spirit) tells the world's story at the milestones of your journey: short lines that never lock you and can be skipped. When off nothing is lost: it all stays in each Journal chapter's "Echoes".
isekai_mahou.configuration.storyMileston: A short cutscene (6 s, controls never locked) at the start of each Act and at the big turns. When off, the narration becomes a spoken line. The general "Cutscenes" option also applies.
story.isekai_mahou.act.1.question: Where am I?
story.isekai_mahou.act.2.question: Who sealed this world?
story.isekai_mahou.act.3: Act III — What the Rupture Left
story.isekai_mahou.act.3.question: What did the Rupture leave behind?
story.isekai_mahou.act.4.question: Where does magic come from?
story.isekai_mahou.act.5.question: Whose side are you on?
story.isekai_mahou.act.6.question: Why me?
story.isekai_mahou.act.7.question: And now?
story.isekai_mahou.act.8.question: How deep can you go?
story.isekai_mahou.a1_call.title: Act I — The Call
story.isekai_mahou.a1_call.narration: Two moons in a sky you do not know. Someone called — and you came.
story.isekai_mahou.a1_call.1: This world is called Asteria. And before you ask: it wasn't quite me who called you. I'm only the Echo of those who did.
story.isekai_mahou.a1_call.2: Before saving anything, survive. I'll tell the rest along the way — only if you want to hear it.
story.isekai_mahou.a1_city.title: Three Kingdoms
story.isekai_mahou.a1_city.1: Aldoria, Sahra and Nordheim: three kingdoms, all built on the rubble of a single empire. Nobody here likes to remember that.
story.isekai_mahou.a1_city.2: The Guild was the idea of a wanderer named Aelis. She never had a home — so she made one for everyone else who didn't.
story.isekai_mahou.a1_trial.title: Made to Measure
story.isekai_mahou.a1_trial.1: Nobody knows who built the Trial Chambers. I have a guess: someone who knew you were coming. They fit a little too well for training outsiders.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_six.title: Act II — The Six
story.isekai_mahou.a2_six.narration: Six sages, six shrines. They did not kill the Dragon: they only locked it away.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_six.1: Pyra, Nerida, Brom, Aelis, Solen and Nyra. They split the Dragon's essence into six pieces and sealed each one in a shrine.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_six.2: Every element you awaken is one of those pieces answering. They like you. I'm not sure that's good.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_shrine.title: The Voice of the Shrine
story.isekai_mahou.a2_shrine.1: "Those who come from afar owe this world nothing. That is exactly why they can save it."
story.isekai_mahou.a2_shrine.2: You heard it too? The shrines keep a trace of the voice that sealed them. That one... I know it from somewhere.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_shadow.title: The Shadow and the Ceiling
story.isekai_mahou.a2_shadow.1: Ascension has a price: facing your own Shadow. You did. Most natives stop at the Third Circle — their souls press up against the Dragon.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_shadow.2: Yours presses against nothing. You came from a world without mana: an empty vessel. There is no ceiling.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_goblin.title: The Ruins of Velmora
story.isekai_mahou.a2_goblin.1: The Horde lives in the ruins of Velmora, the old empire. The Goblin King's throne was a chunk of imperial wall — and he never knew what he was sitting on.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_watcher.title: Someone Is Counting
story.isekai_mahou.a2_watcher.2: Did you feel that? Someone counted your Circles. It wasn't me... and I didn't like that voice.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_seventh.title: The Seventh Name
story.isekai_mahou.a2_seventh.1: The Archmage was expelled from the Academy for studying the Call — the rite that brought you here. They say he found a seventh name in the papers of the Six.
story.isekai_mahou.a2_seventh.2: I should know whose. It's strange... there's a hole in my memory right there.
story.isekai_mahou.a3_rupture.title: Act III — What the Rupture Left
story.isekai_mahou.a3_rupture.narration: A thousand years ago the world cracked in a single night. Much that should have died did not.
story.isekai_mahou.a3_rupture.1: They call it the Great Rupture. The empire of Velmora fell, the Abyss sank, the Sanctuary rose. What you face now is what was left of that night.
story.isekai_mahou.a3_lich.title: Outside the Cycle
story.isekai_mahou.a3_lich.1: The Lich was a necromancer who didn't know when to stop. He meddled with the cycle of souls until he ended up outside it. Like you — only by choice.
story.isekai_mahou.a3_colossus.title: The Last Guard
story.isekai_mahou.a3_colossus.1: The Colossus was still guarding the gates of a city that no longer exists. Nobody told it the empire was over. A thousand years on watch.
story.isekai_mahou.a3_hydra.title: What the Song Erases
story.isekai_mahou.a3_hydra.1: The song erased memories... Funny. There are things I don't remember either — and I never heard any song.
story.isekai_mahou.a4_plane.title: Act IV — The Dragon's Hands
story.isekai_mahou.a4_plane.narration: Above the sky, four guardians wait. They are older than the sages — and they remember everything.
story.isekai_mahou.a4_plane.1: Ignis, Tide, the Golem and Zephyr are the hands of the Dragon that were not sealed with it. They aren't evil. They're loyal. Same thing, when you're standing in front of one.
story.isekai_mahou.a4_guardian.title: The One from Afar
story.isekai_mahou.a4_guardian.1: "The one from afar... again. The last did not return from the Twilight."
story.isekai_mahou.a4_guardian.2: The last one? ...I don't know what it's talking about. I swear. Let's keep going.
story.isekai_mahou.a4_fusion.title: Heresy
story.isekai_mahou.a4_fusion.1: A fusion is two pieces of the essence finding each other again. The old mages called it heresy. I call it missing someone.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_war.title: Act V — Light and Shadow
story.isekai_mahou.a5_war.narration: The Rupture split Light from Shadow. For a thousand years the two halves have fought over who is right.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_war.1: The Abyss Sovereign and the Seraph will offer you exactly the same thing: "end the war". Each from their own side, of course.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_sovereign.title: The First Pact
story.isekai_mahou.a5_sovereign.1: It was the Sovereign who signed the first pact, on the night of the Rupture. Whoever signed across the table became the first demon.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_sovereign.2: Today they call him the Demon King. He raised a citadel in the Nether and, they say, still talks like an emperor.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_balance.title: The Broken Balance
story.isekai_mahou.a5_balance.1: Both have fallen. It was their feud that kept the Twilight asleep — Light on one side, Shadow on the other, and the rift shut between them.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_balance.2: I should have told you sooner. I'm sorry. I only remembered just now.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_demon.title: Still Mine
story.isekai_mahou.a5_demon.1: "This citadel is still mine"... He wasn't talking about the citadel. There is a whole collection of Lost Pages with his confessions. Worth the read.
story.isekai_mahou.a5_demon.2: Aldorians distrust demons more than any other people. There's a family reason behind it.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_called.title: The Herald Calls
story.isekai_mahou.a6_called.narration: Nine Circles. A full vessel. On the far side of the Rift, someone speaks your name.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_called.1: "A thousand years. I only needed one who arrived whole."
story.isekai_mahou.a6_called.2: That voice... I know it. I know it well. Why can't I remember whose it is?
story.isekai_mahou.a6_called.3: You don't have to answer. But he will keep calling.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_rift.title: The First Summoned
story.isekai_mahou.a6_rift.1: The Call that brought you here... he was the first to use it. The first soul that answered, he devoured, to keep its strength. That is what cracked the world.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_rift.2: You don't have to forgive anyone in here. You only have to walk out whole.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_herald.title: Relieve My Post
story.isekai_mahou.a6_herald.narration: "Then... relieve my post." The Herald has fallen. And the Rift did not close.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_herald.1: Relieve his post? He was standing guard. All this time... I think we forgot someone in there.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_herald.2: Look up: the second moon is cracking. That shouldn't happen to a moon.
story.isekai_mahou.a6_hollow.title: The Hungry Souls
story.isekai_mahou.a6_hollow.1: The Hollow World is where souls go when they lose their hearts. The cycle of souls broke in the Rupture; since then, only the hunger is left.
story.isekai_mahou.a7_dragon.title: Act VII — The Origin
story.isekai_mahou.a7_dragon.narration: Before the elements had names, there was only one. It slept for a thousand years. Now it is awake.
story.isekai_mahou.a7_dragon.1: Nothing born of its mana can truly wound it. That is why the Call pulls people from outside — and why it pulled several at once.
story.isekai_mahou.a7_dragon.2: It isn't evil. It is hunger and sleep. Don't try to hate it: just put it back to sleep.
story.isekai_mahou.a7_after.title: It Comes Back
story.isekai_mahou.a7_after.1: It comes back. It always comes back — you can't kill mana. The Six didn't know that.
story.isekai_mahou.a7_after.2: The guardian's post belongs to you now, the summoned. Only this time nobody holds it alone. I'm staying too.
story.isekai_mahou.e_abyss.title: The Shadows
story.isekai_mahou.e_abyss.1: The Shadows aren't the real bosses. They are what the Abyss kept of them: every blow you struck up there left an echo down here.
story.isekai_mahou.e_abyss.2: I don't know if this has a bottom. But it's the only place where the Dragon's ember settles. Go as deep as you like — I'm coming down with you.
story.isekai_mahou.x_lore.title: Lost Pages
story.isekai_mahou.x_lore.1: A Lost Page! These are pieces of what I forgot. Complete a collection and the Encyclopedia opens a Hidden Truth — and each page marks a place on the map, too.
story.isekai_mahou.x_truth.title: A Hidden Truth
story.isekai_mahou.x_truth.1: So that's what it was... Thank you for reminding me. Even if it stings a little.
story.isekai_mahou.x_city.title: A City of Your Own
story.isekai_mahou.x_city.1: A city of your own! Aldoria began like this too: stubborn people, a handful of survivors and an empty field.
story.isekai_mahou.x_city.2: Look after your people's Happiness. Happy folk build faster, draw in neighbors... and throw two-day festivals.
story.isekai_mahou.x_towers.title: Win or Turn Back
story.isekai_mahou.x_towers.2: It's carved on every tower, in the same hand. Someone insisted on it. The Chronicles of Velmora say who — if you find the pages.
story.isekai_mahou.x_dwarf.title: We Never Left
story.isekai_mahou.x_dwarf.1: The dwarves went below in the Ashen Years and the world thought they had vanished. "We never left," they say. "We just shut the door."
story.isekai_mahou.x_depths.title: Mana in the Stone
story.isekai_mahou.x_depths.1: The deeper you go, the more mana in the stone. The Worm King has eaten mana geodes for so long that crystals grew on its shell.
story.isekai_mahou.x_library.title: The Sky Outside
story.isekai_mahou.x_library.1: The End is what was left outside when the world cracked. This library keeps the grammar of space — and the Star Devourer eats what remains of the sky out there.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_found.where: Founding Charter: the Scribe in the starting city sells one a day; or, at the crafting table, book and quill in the middle, a gold ingot on each side and a paper above and below. For a sky city, the Sky Core: the Alchemist sells it, or 2 feathers, 2 amethyst shards and 1 Mana Crystal.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_found.how: Hold the Charter: a hologram shows the plaza, the first 24 plots and the wall on the ground (green = good, yellow = slope, blue = water, red = not here). Right-click pins it; arrows move it (Ctrl = 4 blocks) and R rotates; right-click again (or Enter) opens the style and name screen. The Charter is only spent when the city is really founded.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_build.where: City panel (click the City Heart) → Plan and Works tabs.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_build.how: Builders raise everything by themselves, at no resource cost. Their cap is 2 + the center's level, +2 per Builders' Hall level and +1 per Workshop (up to 24). Each builder runs one work; spare ones help (+50% speed each). "Free position…" lets you pick a building's spot and facing, and a finished building can be moved for coins from the treasury.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_happiness.where: City panel → Happiness tab: it shows the mood, each of today's reasons (+ or −) and what weighs the most.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_happiness.how: Food, fuel, housing, security, leisure and low taxes raise Happiness. At 70 or more the city produces more, builds 10–20% faster, gets double immigration and one extra caravan. It never drops more than 10 a day; below 10 for 3 days in a row the people revolt — with a warning each day.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_festival.where: City panel: the Lord decrees the Festival. The feast needs food in the granary.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_festival.how: It lasts 2 game days, with street decorations and fireworks at night. It gives +8 Happiness at the start and +4 per day, +30% taxes and +20% caravans. A new festival can be decreed 5 days after the last one began.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_caravans.where: City panel → Caravans and Resources tabs. Caravans need a built Market.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_caravans.how: A caravan goes to one of the 10 nearest cities or villages (even other players') to sell or buy food and fuel, or to trade goods. Farther pays more; repeated same-day trips to one city flood its market. Mine, sawmill, farm and port send goods to the storehouse every day, and "Collect all" takes taxes and goods from anywhere inside the city.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_defense.how: During sieges the Watchtowers, the wall towers and the Magic Tower shoot the horde; the Trap Field hurts and slows it; the Barracks strengthen guards and militia. With a Watchtower, scouts warn you a day ahead.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_magic.where: In your Grimoire and in the city's arcane buildings.
guide.isekai_mahou.city_magic.how: Put the Work Boost effect in a spell and cast it near a work site: the builders work faster. At the Arcane Barrier, click the catalyst with a Spell Scroll to record the defense it casts on invaders. None of your spells damage the city.
guide.isekai_mahou.home_key.where: From the Innkeeper of any kingdom city: 128 Guild Coins.
guide.isekai_mahou.home_key.how: Use the key to get your island: a furnished house, a farm, a pond and room to build. After that, the Home key (or B menu → Travel Guide → Home) takes you there and back — only after 2 minutes out of combat. Nobody takes damage there, and you can invite friends from the tab.
guide.isekai_mahou.inn.where: With the Innkeeper, at the inn of every city.
guide.isekai_mahou.inn.how: Resting (5 coins) refills health and mana and grants Well Rested for 10 min. A room for 3 or 7 days (14 or 28 coins) becomes your respawn point. Paid rumors point to boss lairs (8) and dungeons or towers (5), and only charge if something is found. He also sells the Scroll of Return and Bond Incense.
guide.isekai_mahou.altars: Altars of New Beginnings and Reincarnation
guide.isekai_mahou.altars.where: In the kingdoms' capitals, on opposite sides of the plaza. There are also rare shrines in the world (they become map markers), and both altars have recipes.
guide.isekai_mahou.altars.how: New Beginnings: refunds every talent point and undoes the specialization for 12 Mana Crystals. Reincarnation: changing race costs 32 Crystals + 1 Guardian Core; changing class, 64 + 1 Core. Level, Circle and elements stay; whatever belonged only to the old class is lost.
guide.isekai_mahou.market_board.where: Market Board, in every city's plaza; sneak + click on a Quest Board opens it too. From level 5: B menu → Market.
guide.isekai_mahou.market_board.how: Sell and buy with Guild Coins, even while the seller is offline. The fee is 5% on a sale. Each player has up to 10 listings; they expire after 7 real days and the item returns to your collection box.
guide.isekai_mahou.renown_board.where: Beside the Quest Board in cities, or B menu → Renown.
guide.isekai_mahou.renown_board.how: It shows the Ranking (level, bosses, Abyss floor, towers, richest and most populous city), the Titles to wear above your name and the time Records against each boss.
guide.isekai_mahou.mounts.where: Land Drake: reins at the Guild shop (rank E, 45 coins) or from the Innkeeper (Friendly reputation); you can also tame a wild one in savanna or plains with meat. Nightmare: 1 in 6 chance per boss (guaranteed on the 6th). Aurora Stag: a gift on reaching Honored with one of the kingdoms.
guide.isekai_mahou.mounts.how: The Reins call the mount already tamed and saddled; if it dies, the Reins come back to you. The R key uses the mount's ability.
guide.isekai_mahou.vehicles.where: From the Mechanic: in your city's Mechanic's Workshop (more vehicles each level) or on the plaza of world cities (more vehicles with standing in the kingdom). Only the Arcane Boat is still crafted.
guide.isekai_mahou.vehicles.how: They run on your mana (always leaving 25%) and then on the tank — charge it by clicking with a Mana Crystal (crystals in the hold refill it by themselves). Monsters and explosions damage them: a Repair Kit or the Mechanic fixes them, and he rebuilds a destroyed one. Sneak + hit packs the vehicle into an item, with charge, health and upgrades.
guide.isekai_mahou.talents.how: You earn 1 point per level. Each class has 3 branches; each node needs a minimum level and 3 points in the node above. At Circle 5 you pick 1 of 2 specializations. To redo it all: Altar of New Beginnings.
guide.isekai_mahou.glyph_mastery: Glyph Mastery and the spell's Circle
guide.isekai_mahou.glyph_mastery.where: Only by using them: every glyph in a spell gains experience when the effect really lands (enemies are worth more; casting into the air is worth nothing). The level shows in the Glyphs tab and in the Grimoire.
guide.isekai_mahou.glyph_mastery.how: Mastery never ends: I, II... X, XI... ★ 57... Each level takes a little off that glyph's mana cost and, for effect glyphs, adds power (slowly, with no cap). Each level needs a bit more use than the last. At level IV (about 300 hits) the first MUTATION arrives, and more come every few levels — ever more bizarre (after ★ 45, an Aberration every 5 levels). Some anime glyphs also EVOLVE with their own names, like Tusk's Acts (Chidori → Raikiri → Kirin, Gomu Gomu → Gear 4...). Someone who used a spell a thousand times is stronger with it than someone who just learned it — even at a lower level.
guide.isekai_mahou.transformation.where: The Transformation form comes from the Arcane path, at Circle 5. Build the recipe in the Grimoire, like a Domain: Transformation + effects + laws.
guide.isekai_mahou.transformation.how: In the Grimoire, click the Transformation glyph (the first in the palette): pick the transformation (race key, release, form), add effects, augments and Vows, and save. It layers on top of your form when you transform: attack effects ride on your hits and support effects pulse on you.
guide.isekai_mahou.summons.where: In the Grimoire: the Conjuration form + a summon glyph (salamander, undine, golem, sylph, fairy, shadow or ent) + effects.
guide.isekai_mahou.summons.how: The creature spawns instead of the spirit and uses the recipe's effects on its hits. Split = how many, Expand and Concentrate = size, Extend = duration, Amplify = strength. Orders (follow, guard a point, hunt the target, stay): the O key, sneak + click on the summon, or the Order glyphs.
guide.isekai_mahou.familiar.where: Bond Incense: from the Innkeeper (14 coins) or at the crafting table (arcane essence + mana crystal + feather + bone + honeycomb).
guide.isekai_mahou.familiar.how: From level 10, hold the incense for 4 s near a lit campfire. The Familiar takes the shape of how you play and changes with you. It doesn't fight: it helps (fetches items, warns of danger, heals a little), carries a bag and can learn one of your support spells. It grows at level 30 and 75.
guide.isekai_mahou.gems.where: From mining ores (small chance), bosses (1 cut gem), rarely from monsters, and from the city Jeweler (chipped gems at Friendly reputation; the Chisel costs 16 coins). Three equal gems at the crafting table become the next cut.
guide.isekai_mahou.gems.how: Only the Smith, Rune Knight and Enchanter can socket: click the gem onto the item in the inventory (the chisel takes the last one out). Weapons have 3 sockets (levels 10, 35 and 60) and each armor piece has 1 (level 20).
guide.isekai_mahou.gear.how: Four pieces of the same set give a bonus. Lost your class kit? Recovery returns the missing pieces, at the best tier you have carried, free every 40 min of play (or for 4 Mana Crystals). Kills with the class weapon in hand raise its Bond (1 to 10): +1.5% damage per level and an ability at 10.
guide.isekai_mahou.endless_abyss.how: Endless floors, each one stronger; every 5th brings the Shadow of a boss you have beaten. It pays Abyss Shards, Shadow Fragments and, every 10 new floors, an Abyss Core. Dying or leaving returns you to where you entered, with no item loss. A party mate of level 100+ can join during the pause between floors.
guide.isekai_mahou.lock_guard.where: No item needed: they are keys (rebind them in Options → Controls → Isekai Mahou).
guide.isekai_mahou.lock_guard.how: The middle mouse button locks onto the enemy nearest the crosshair; the wheel switches target. Holding Mouse 4 with a weapon or staff in hand blocks half the damage coming from the front. Pressing right as the hit lands (0.3 s) PARRIES: the hit is cancelled and the attacker is stunned. A very heavy hit breaks your guard — parry or dodge that one.
guide.isekai_mahou.finisher_combo.where: In any fight against common monsters.
guide.isekai_mahou.finisher_combo.how: A common enemy below 10% health staggers: get close and right-click for the mercy stroke. Casting a spell within 4 s of the last one builds a Combo: +2% power per spell, up to +20%. Stop and it resets.
guide.isekai_mahou.portals.where: B menu → Travel Guide → Places → "Portal Guide".
guide.isekai_mahou.portals.how: For each dimension it shows where the portal is, how to open it and what is still missing (Circle, bosses). "Track the nearest" puts an arrow on the tracker. Places you discover also become minimap points.
guide.isekai_mahou.puzzles.where: One per floor of the Layered Dungeon, and also in the Demon Citadel, the Void Library and the Dwarf Hold's vault. Look for the Rune Seal.
guide.isekai_mahou.puzzles.how: There are four kinds: levers that light lamps in groups, stepping on every plate exactly once, steering a light beam through 3 mirrors and repeating a rune sequence. Solving one opens the grates around the chest and gives XP.
guide.isekai_mahou.towers.where: Towers across the world (stone, sand, frost, forest, sunken and floating). Sky islands with ruins hang in the sky: a glowing Updraft rises to them.
guide.isekai_mahou.towers.how: Each floor may have affixes (Fortified, Swift, Burning monsters...): hover their names in chat to see what they do. The game keeps your best time. Inn rumors point to the nearest tower.
guide.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.where: Crystal Forest: parts of cold forests and taigas. Haunted Swamp: the wetter side of swamps. Twilight Grove: the heart of dark forests. Magic Crystal Cavern: beneath very dry land. Embercrystal Wastes: Nether. Astral Gardens: the outer End islands.
guide.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.how: They only generate in new terrain (areas not explored yet). The Crystal Forest and the Magic Crystal Cavern give +15% mana regeneration while you are inside.
guide.isekai_mahou.lore_pages.where: Lost Pages: in chests (the mod's and the game's), in the Ruins of Velmora and in buried treasure. Ancient Steles: carved stones inside the ruins.
guide.isekai_mahou.lore_pages.how: Reading a page reveals a Fragment and marks on the tracker the place it speaks of (structure, boss lair or treasure), with coordinates. Completing a collection unlocks a Hidden Truth in the Encyclopedia (B menu → Travel Guide → Encyclopedia).
guide.isekai_mahou.world_events.where: They happen on their own in the Overworld: Meteor Fall, Blood Moon, Arcane Storm, Earthquake and Mana Storm.
guide.isekai_mahou.world_events.how: The meteor leaves a crater with Star Ore and brings invaders (the Star Herald is the mini-boss); the city Blacksmith buys Star Metal. The Blood Moon brings more monsters and more XP. The storms make spells stronger. No event ever damages cities.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.first_spe: every glyph gains Mastery with use (I to X): it costs less mana and hits harder. Casting into the air doesn't count.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.slime_hun: the middle mouse button locks onto a target; holding Mouse 4 blocks and, pressed right as the hit lands, parries. A nearly dead enemy staggers: right-click up close for the mercy stroke.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.re: in the city, the Innkeeper sells the Home Key (128 coins), the plaza has the Market Board and the Renown Board stands beside the Quest Board. In capitals, the plaza has the Altars of New Beginnings and Reincarnation.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.le: at level 2 the Talents tab opens in the B menu (1 point per level) and, at 5, the player Market.
at level 10 you can perform the Familiar ritual: Bond Incense (Innkeeper, 14 coins) held near a lit campfire.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.shrine_: small ruins across the world hold Ancient Steles and Lost Pages — reading one marks a place on the map and fills the Encyclopedia.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.third_c: at Circle 3 the Conjuration form takes summon and Order glyphs: the creature is born shaped by your recipe (the O key gives the orders).
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.fifth_: at Circle 5 the Arcane path teaches the Transformation form — shape your transformations and Vows in the Grimoire through the Transformation glyph — and the Talents tab unlocks your class specialization.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.ninth_circ: at level 100 the Endless Abyss opens in the B menu: endless floors and the Shadows of bosses you have already beaten.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.primordi: the Dragon is the end of the story. After it only the Endless Abyss remains (B menu → Abyss) — and the level ceiling rises from 150 to 200.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.explor: Where mana leaked into the land, even the ground glows. One is enough to understand why no one raises cities there.

Follow the journal compass to the nearest Enchanted Land: Crystal Forest (cool forests), Haunted Swamp, Twilight Grove (Dark Forests) or a Crystal Cavern. They only generate in new terrain: if the arrow vanishes, explore farther.
journal.isekai_mahou.magic_biomes.outro: You have seen where mana soaks the land — and came back to tell of it. The other Enchanted Lands are still out there, each with crystals of its own.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.false_hydra_head.d: One of the False Hydra's heads. It only exists while nobody looks at it — and it sings so you forget you looked.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.vault_mimic.desc: A chest with teeth that serves the Mimic King. In his vault, distrust anything that looks like treasure.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.afterlife_reaper.d: It comes for souls that take too long to return to their bodies. No hurry, no anger: only duty.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.void_scribe.desc: A scribe of the Void Library, in the End. It has copied the grammar of space for a thousand years and dislikes readers.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.star_wisp.desc: A spark from a sky that no longer exists. It drifts between the shelves of the Void Library and bursts into cold light.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.trial_guard.desc: A conjured soldier of the Trial Chambers. It isn't real — but it hits as if it were.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.desc: It sleeps in the observatory of the Void Library and eats what is left of the sky outside. One of the strongest bosses in the End.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.desc: The Sixth Espada of Las Noches: a panther shaped like a man. He fights for the joy of it and gets faster the more he is hurt.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.barragan.desc: God-King of Hueco Mundo, Old Age itself. Everything that comes near him ages and turns to dust.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.desc: The Fourth Espada: black wings and a hole in his chest. He guards the depths of Las Noches and does not understand what a heart is.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.trial_champion.des: The best of the Trial Chambers: it appears for those who beat the waves and still want more.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.city_champion.desc: The defender of a sworn city. Whoever beats him with the Oath Seal becomes its Lord.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.familiar_spirit.de: Your Familiar: born from the Bond Incense, it takes the shape of how you play and changes with you. It doesn't fight — it helps, and carries a bag.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.citizen.desc: Ordinary folk of the kingdoms' cities. They work by day, drop by the inn at night and sometimes have a request for you.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.city_guard.desc: A guard of the kingdoms' cities. Protects the people, shuts the gate on the horde and dislikes magic near the houses.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.city_merchant.desc: A city merchant: blacksmith, alchemist, jeweler, innkeeper... Prices improve with your reputation.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.city_lord.desc: The one who rules a kingdom city. Hands out the most serious quests — and remembers who helped.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.settlement_residen: A resident of YOUR city. Happy, they work better and call their relatives; unhappy, they complain — and one day revolt.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.settlement_builder: A builder of your city: raises houses, walls and towers alone. The more builders, the more works at once.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.settlement_guard.d: A guard of your city. Patrols the streets and holds the line when the horde arrives.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.settlement_militia: A resident who takes up arms when the city is attacked. With a Barracks, they fight much better.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.settlement_merchan: A merchant of your city. Opens shop at the Market and travels with the caravans to neighboring cities.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.dwarf_merchant.des: A trader of the Dwarf Hold. Swaps mithril and runes for surface goods — and haggles like nobody else.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.dwarf_smith.desc: A dwarven smith, heir to Pyra's runes. Works at the Rune Forge, deep in the hold.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hellfire_imp.desc: An imp of black flames summoned by the Infernal fusion. Small, fast and very rude.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.twilight_clone.des: A copy of you made of Twilight: it fights beside you for a few moments and comes apart into light and shadow.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.dark_young.desc: A Dark Young called by a Legendary Spell: a mass of tentacles and hooves that tramples everything in its way.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.kodama.desc: A small spirit of the trees, called by the Druid's techniques. Where there are kodama, the forest is healthy.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.forest_god.desc: The Forest God, summoned by the Druid's greatest technique. Where it steps, life sprouts — and enemies wither.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.shadow_soldier.des: A soldier raised from the shadow of a fallen enemy. It obeys the Necromancer without speaking or retreating.
A giant of pure mana raised by an ultimate. It lasts a short while — and crushes a great deal.
